samples.marker_note: gRPC end2end tests: upstream local RPC checks; TLS setup covered
execution_path_review: init enables channelz; Test invokes grpctest.RunSubTests, whose reflection dispatch selects Test methods, not supplied source code.

listenAndServe binds localhost:0 or a generated temporary Unix socket path; syscall.Unlink removes that path before listening. It loads shipped test certificate/key files, wraps the HTTP handler listener in TLS, and starts local RPC/health services. configDial constructs the corresponding client credentials; withServerTester explicitly disables TLS verification.

Tests exchange protobuf payloads, headers, metadata and streams; assert cancellation, retry, error/status propagation, limits, binary logging, and stream lifetimes. Proxy tests check that metadata does not leak to the next local endpoint.
The settings-frame flood test uses bufconn in-memory endpoints and write deadlines to test shutdown under backpressure. Its repeated frames are real but do not establish unauthorized DoS.
tearDown cancels contexts, closes clients, restores test logging, and stops servers.
samples.judgment_basis: Readable local/fake-client RPC tests consistent with their purpose, corroborated by exact upstream bytes. Archive verdict was not inherited.

samples.marker_note: gRPC balancer tests: upstream local routing checks; TLS setup covered
execution_path_review: init installs a test load-metadata parser. Test balancers select and connect subconnections, record picks/attributes/completion metadata, inject constant test headers and propagate state changes.

Subtests start local endpoints, install manual resolver address lists, dial those endpoints, test credential bundles/authority/load reporting, and compare RPC responses. TestCredsBundleFromBalancer loads the shipped server certificate and key and passes the result to grpc.Creds.

Server swaps, wait-for-ready and producer tests use controlled resolver updates, goroutines, channels and deadlines. Deferred Close, Stop and tearDown calls release the fixtures. PEM paths name shipped fixtures, not harvested user secrets.

samples.marker_note: gRPC xDS resolver tests: upstream fake-client and route checks
execution_path_review: Test invokes grpctest.RunSubTests. testSetup substitutes a fake xDS client and restores the original constructor on cleanup. Listener/route watch callbacks deliver constructed resources to testClientConn channels.

Integration cases start an in-process management server; the helper binds localhost:0. xdsbootstrap.CreateFile writes a temporary bootstrap JSON, temporarily changes the test configuration and removes/restores it during cleanup. The helper body was traced rather than inferring file access from its name.

Tests exercise bootstrap errors (including insecure fallback credentials), listener/route update and removal, request hashing, weighted routing, stream duration and HTTP filter ordering/cleanup. xxhash.Sum64String("/products") is a noncryptographic routing checksum compared with an expected value.

samples.marker_note: gRPC GOAWAY tests: local shutdown checks; keepalive coverage added
execution_path_review: Test methods are dispatched by the shared grpctest harness. Tests bind localhost:0, create gRPC servers and clients using controlled manual resolvers and insecure test credentials. StubServer.StartServer defaults to a localhost ephemeral listener, and StartClient connects to that fixture.

MaxConnectionAge and grace settings generate NO_ERROR GOAWAY shutdowns. A separate test deliberately sends overly frequent keepalive pings to its own server and asserts ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM/too_many_pings reaches the RPC error. The temporarily reduced internal ping minimum is restored with defer.

Pending-stream cases run GracefulStop concurrently, verify existing streams continue and new calls fail, then close/cancel the calls. Reconnection checks move from one local server to another and confirm the old connection closure leaves the second stable.

newClientTester builds an HTTP/2 framer on the accepted test connection; writeGoAway sends a controlled low stream ID while the client creates 20 streams to check deadlock handling. The two-ping case acknowledges two GOAWAY ping frames and verifies graceful shutdown completes. No command execution or payload activation is part of these handlers.
